text_en: In the third year of the reign of King Jehoiakim of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
text_cn: 犹大王约雅金在位第三年，巴比伦王拿步高前来围攻耶路撒冷，

text_en: The Lord let King Jehoiakim of Judah fall into his power, as well as some of the vessels of the house of God. These he brought to the land of Shinar, and placed the vessels in the treasury of his gods.
text_cn: 上主将犹大王约雅金和天主殿内的一部分器皿，交在拿步高手中，他便将这些器皿带到史纳尔地方，存放在他神殿的库房内。

text_en: Then the king commanded his palace master Ashpenaz to bring some of the Israelites of the royal family and of the nobility,
text_cn: 君王吩咐他的宦官长阿市培纳次，要他由以色列子民中，选一些王室或贵族的青年，

text_en: young men without physical defect and handsome, versed in every branch of wisdom, endowed with knowledge and insight, and competent to serve in the king’s palace; they were to be taught the literature and language of the Chaldeans.
text_cn: 他们应没有缺陷，容貌俊美，足智多才，富有知识，明察事理，适合在王宫内充当侍从，应教给他们加色丁文字和语言。

text_en: The king assigned them a daily portion of the royal rations of food and wine. They were to be educated for three years, so that at the end of that time they could be stationed in the king’s court.
text_cn: 君王且给他们指定了，每天要吃君王所吃的食品和所饮的美酒，如此教养他们三年；期满以后，他们便可侍立在君王左右。

text_en: Among them were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, from the tribe of Judah.
text_cn: 他们中为犹大后裔的，有达尼尔、阿纳尼雅、米沙耳和阿匝黎雅。

text_en: The palace master gave them other names: Daniel he called Belteshazzar, Hananiah he called Shadrach, Mishael he called Meshach, and Azariah he called Abednego.
text_cn: 宦官长另给他们起了名字：给达尼尔起名叫贝耳特沙匝，阿纳尼雅叫沙得辣客，米沙耳叫默沙客，阿匝黎雅叫阿贝得乃哥。

text_en: But Daniel resolved that he would not defile himself with the royal rations of food and wine; so he asked the palace master to allow him not to defile himself.
text_cn: 但是达尼尔心中早已拿定主意，决不让自己为君王的食品和君王饮的美酒所玷污，所以他请求宦官长使自己免受此玷污。

text_en: Now God allowed Daniel to receive favor and compassion from the palace master.
text_cn: 天主赏达尼尔在宦官长眼中获得宠遇和同情。

text_en: The palace master said to Daniel, “I am afraid of my lord the king; he has appointed your food and your drink. If he should see you in poorer condition than the other young men of your own age, you would endanger my head with the king. ”
text_cn: 宦官长对达尼尔说：“我害怕我的主上君王，他原给你们指定了饮食，若见你们的面容比你们同年的青年消瘦，这样你们岂不是将我的头断送给君王！”

text_en: Then Daniel asked the guard whom the palace master had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
text_cn: 达尼尔对宦官长派来照管达尼尔、阿纳尼雅、米沙耳和阿匝黎雅的人说：

text_en: “Please test your servants for ten days. Let us be given vegetables to eat and water to drink.
text_cn: “请你一连十天试一试你的仆人们，只给我们蔬菜吃，清水喝；

text_en: You can then compare our appearance with the appearance of the young men who eat the royal rations, and deal with your servants according to what you observe. ”
text_cn: 然后，你亲自观察我们的容貌，和那些吃君王食品的青年的容貌，就照你所观察的，对待你的仆人们吧！”

text_en: So he agreed to this proposal and tested them for ten days.
text_cn: 他答应了他们的要求，试验了他们十天。

text_en: At the end of ten days it was observed that they appeared better and fatter than all the young men who had been eating the royal rations.
text_cn: 十天以后，他们的容貌比那些吃君王食品的青年显得更为美丽，肌肉更为丰满。

text_en: So the guard continued to withdraw their royal rations and the wine they were to drink, and gave them vegetables.
text_cn: 负责照管的人，遂将他们的食品和应喝的美酒撤去，只给他们蔬菜。

text_en: To these four young men God gave knowledge and skill in every aspect of literature and wisdom; Daniel also had insight into all visions and dreams.
text_cn: 至于这四个青年，天主赐给了他们精通各种文字和学问的才智与聪明，而且达尼尔还通晓各种神视和梦兆。

text_en: At the end of the time that the king had set for them to be brought in, the palace master brought them into the presence of Nebuchadnezzar,
text_cn: 君王规定带他们进宫的期限一满，宦官长就领他们进见拿步高。

text_en: and the king spoke with them. And among them all, no one was found to compare with Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; therefore they were stationed in the king’s court.
text_cn: 君王和他们交谈，发现其中没有一个能及得上达尼尔、阿纳尼雅、米沙耳和阿匝黎雅的，于是他们随侍在君王前，

text_en: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his whole kingdom.
text_cn: 君王无论询问他们什么智识和学问，发现他们都十倍胜于自己全国所有的巫师和术士。

text_en: And Daniel continued there until the first year of King Cyrus.
text_cn: 达尼尔就这样一直到居鲁士王元年。
